style_summary: Extreme wide-angle action photography with an enlarged near-lens object, saturated blue environmental depth, one acid-colored angular burst behind the subject and oversized lean typography sweeping diagonally through the foreground.

environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: Original identities and composition to replace
environment_variables.SUBJECT: Photographic action and environment
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: explosive mid-motion athletic movement caught at its peak instant
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: the enlarged sports object sitting closest to the wide-angle lens
environment_variables.LOCATION: a saturated blue sports environment receding steeply behind the subject
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: deep environmental perspective, motion streaks and the angular acid-colored burst shape
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: compact supporting labels set against the oversized headline
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: the angular acid-colored burst wedge behind the subject
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: athletic kit matched to the sport, in colors that hold against the acid accent

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] A believable dynamic wide-angle photograph with dramatic near/far scale: one relevant object or limb enters near the lens while the connected adult subject recedes; saturated blue sky or environmental field creates deep contrast.

[CORE] One flat hard-edged asymmetric jagged burst in a vivid acid ink sits behind the main subject, with real photographic silhouette occluding it. It is a graphic plane, not a glow, splash or many small decorative stars.

[CORE] Huge lean regular-weight geometric/neo-grotesk lettering in the same acid ink sweeps on an oblique diagonal through foreground space. Use open counters, tight expressive line relationships and readable words; no bold block, handwritten lettering or colored text boxes.
[FLEX] Burst contour and long spikes answer the action's force or direction; source crown-like spike count and exact placement are not mandatory.
[FLEX] Choose foreground object, pose, camera, environment and crop according to the theme; do not repeat a rear-view runner and shoe sole.
[FLEX] Headline angle, word scale and line breaks respond to the action and change for each ratio. Minor photographic overlap allowed while headline remains readable.
[FLEX] Acid hue may change within a vivid high-contrast family, retaining a shared ink for shape and type; keep sparse graphic inventory.
source_content_to_avoid: Original Russian headline and small brand lockup
Original rear-view runner, sports vest and source shoe identity
Exact crown-like burst outline and original word stacking
Exact asphalt mountain-road crop and source logos

visual_deconstruction.observation: A rear runner's sole looms into left foreground; bright yellow angular burst rises behind torso against blue sky; large light sans Cyrillic headline fans across lower half at a tilt.
visual_deconstruction.transfer: Transfer the depth, shared graphic/type ink, lean slanted hierarchy and behind-subject burst. Use each new action to generate another spatial relationship; low-resolution source compression is not a desired artifact.

composition.portrait: Near object, receding action and diagonal headline make a tall interlocking sequence; burst partly hidden behind subject.
composition.landscape: Action traverses width with independently redistributed headline; no portrait pasted into wide canvas.

typography.headline: Very large lean regular sans, open circular counters, compact spacing, oblique layout rather than heavy italic font; no filled text rectangles.
typography.secondary: One small clean sans line in accent ink, subordinate.

color_palette.system: Saturated blues and natural photo colors contrasted with one flat acid ink used by both burst and title.

image_treatment.texture: Fine subtle photographic grain and mild optical softness; clean flat graphic edges. Do not emulate compression blocks, heavy distress or old paper.
image_treatment.light: Clear outdoor daylight and grounded shadows; no grey overcast requirement inherited from previous project.

design_rules: Show believable anatomy and object connections despite perspective.
Keep the burst behind the main body with meaningful occlusion.
Make lean large type an active part of movement, not a generic horizontal headline.
Use only one dominant burst and one short support line; avoid clutter.
do: Let action determine burst geometry and text trajectory.
Retain strong color contrast and large depth cues.
avoid: Near-copy runner pose with a swapped shoe.
Heavy fonts, stickers, highlighter bars or multiple star decorations.
Disconnected equipment, anatomical distortions, unreadable words.
negative_prompt: No original slogan or brands, no watermark, no creator signature, no thick block typography, no text boxes, no comic ink outlines, no duplicated body, no arbitrary floating objects.
prompt_template: Create one full-bleed photographic action poster. {STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS} Scene: {SUBJECT}. Required large headline exactly: "{MAIN_TEXT}". Small supporting line exactly: "{SMALL_TEXT}". Graphic/type ink: {ACCENT}. Portrait direction: {DIRECTION}. For landscape instead: {WIDE_DIRECTION}. One flat jagged burst sits behind the main human silhouette; foreground object and body remain naturally photographed. Set headline in very large LIGHT/REGULAR geometric sans with thin even strokes, not heavy bold; angle the block and vary word scales so it participates in movement. The shape and letters share the vivid ink. Preserve required wording. Sparse high-impact layout, natural shadows and saturated blue environment. Exclude {SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID}. No logos or extra text.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female basketball player making a forceful low crossover dribble on an outdoor blue court. Camera a few inches above the floor beside the near orange basketball, which looms in foreground but remains below her connected open hand; she lunges sideways with both feet on court, torso receding toward deep blue sky. Plain black and white sportswear, no logos.
values.DIRECTION: Near ball anchors lower left, body cuts sideways to upper right. A slashing asymmetric burst behind shoulders mirrors the crossover. Three lean text lines swing across lower/right floor space at a rising angle, suggesting a change of direction rather than a rear kick.
values.WIDE_DIRECTION: Ball at one near corner and lunging player stretch across center; burst reaches behind torso, headline sweeps across opposite open court in two staggered angled lines.

values.SUBJECT: An adult male kayaker in a compact whitewater kayak on dark cobalt water. Very low camera beside one wet paddle blade entering near foreground, blade visibly connected through one continuous shaft gripped by both hands. Seated body braces into a paddle stroke, yellow helmet and dark buoyancy vest, white splashes restrained, blue river gorge and sky.
values.DIRECTION: Paddle blade and continuous shaft create a diagonal across foreground; burst behind paddler fans toward the stroke's trailing side. Lean huge headline bends its stepped baseline across lower water, allowing paddle shaft to cross a gap between words.
values.WIDE_DIRECTION: Kayak crosses width, near blade at lower right and paddler at left-middle. Burst behind paddler radiates sideways; headline angles across the opposite water gap in a broad two-line rhythm.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female tennis player reaching into a low backhand return on an outdoor cobalt tennis court. Camera near the unbranded racket head so the string bed appears large in foreground; one continuous racket throat and handle connect to both hands; athletic body follows behind in a side lunge. Small yellow ball near racket but not hiding strings. Deep blue sky, simple neutral kit.
values.DIRECTION: Near racket oval leads eye to two-handed grip and lunging figure. Burst has one extended wedge following the return direction behind torso. Large lean text diagonally occupies clear lower court beside racket, with varying word widths forming a counter-swing.
values.WIDE_DIRECTION: Racket enters from far near left, body lunges through center and the burst extends behind toward right. Typography sweeps through lower-right court with complete wording and avoids racket strings.

values.SUBJECT: An adult male skateboarder wearing a simple helmet carving along the curved wall of a blue concrete bowl, both feet planted on one continuous skateboard deck. Camera close to the front truck and wheels, foreshortened deck sweeping up to a crouched sideways rider. Wheels contacting curved concrete, deep blue sky above rim, neutral grey clothing. No airborne trick.
values.DIRECTION: Bowl curve and board create an arc instead of a straight kick. Jagged burst behind crouched rider is swept sideways like a sharp counterweight. Lean giant type tilts with the bowl's curvature in foreground, without becoming painted-on-ground text or hiding the deck.
values.WIDE_DIRECTION: Bowl lip arcs across wide scene; near truck at lower center, rider bends to one side, burst shoots toward opposite sky. Two or three oblique text tiers fill open concrete on the other side.
